{"question": "患者从何时开始独立制作这份早餐？过去由他人制作时添加了什么额外成分？", "context": [{"id": "MEM-1", "content": "用户是在搬去独居后才开始自己煮燕麦粥的，大约六年前（2020年左右）。之前住家时是母亲做给她吃的。", "metadata": {"evaluation": "synthetic-component-v2", "type": "consultation_event", "timestamp": "2026-09-08T09:58:27.863801+00:00", "source_session_id": "session-2", "user_id": "M10-10", "agent_id": "component-v2", "attributed_to": "user"}}, {"id": "MEM-2", "content": "用户以前住家时吃母亲做的燕麦粥经常加蜂蜜，与现在独居后加的蓝莓和坚果不同。", "metadata": {"evaluation": "synthetic-component-v2", "type": "consultation_event", "timestamp": "2026-09-08T09:58:27.863801+00:00", "source_session_id": "session-2", "user_id": "M10-10", "agent_id": "component-v2", "attributed_to": "user"}}, {"id": "MEM-3", "content": "用户习惯早餐吃燕麦粥，加了蓝莓和坚果。这个习惯是母亲教她的，认为这样营养均衡，已经坚持了十几年。", "metadata": {"evaluation": "synthetic-component-v2", "type": "consultation_event", "timestamp": "2026-09-08T09:58:11.986863+00:00", "source_session_id": "session-1", "user_id": "M10-10", "agent_id": "component-v2", "attributed_to": "user"}}]}
